alex: Hey team — PR #8427 is ready but we need arch signoff. RFC linked below. Gating merge on that. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8427 RFC: https://rfc.redwood.ai/r/123-kv-routing :eyes:

maria: Taking a look. What's the SLO/latency risk if we roll this? Any perf numbers?

alex: Short answer: tail p95 latency could jump on 2-token bursts if KV routing misses. Ran a quick perf run, numbers pasted below. Can keep canary at 10% for 48h. Also added a small config snippet to PR.

jiwon: can you paste the perf run output here? Also what metrics to watch in console (routes, cache-hit)?

infra-bot: CI checks: unit tests ✅, integration tests ❌ (flaky timeout on serves). See CI details: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9876 :robot_face:

alex: Perf run (local, seq len 64, 8 GPUs):
```
baseline p95: 48ms
pr changes p95: 62ms
kv-cache hit rate: 88%
requests/sec: -7%
```
Added canary policy: 10% steady, 2x burst headroom. PR description updated.

maria: ok, add RFC link to PR description and point to RFC section 4.2 (routing fallback). I'll do arch review once that's in the PR. Also add a quick note about rollback trigger (10% error or 20% latency regression).

alex: done — RFC link added and rollback thresholds in PR body.

jiwon: also add a dashboard widget for kv-cache hit rate + p95 token latency, tag with pr-8427.

maria: Assigning to me for final arch signoff. Expect notes within EOD PST. :calendar:

alex: thanks. ping me if you need more perf runs.

maria: Arch ack: LGTM for merge after CI green and canary run starts. I'll leave a formal comment on the PR. :shipit:

alex: merging once CI passes and canary scheduler picks it up. Will monitor metrics and post updates.
